title: Nvidia GPUs are everywhere. Here are the ways companies are accessing them
summary: Industry research shows more than 300 neoclouds now offer GPU capacity, representing a 55% increase in less than a year. This expansion reflects growing demand for GPU access and highlights multiple pathways for companies to obtain computing resources.
content: One industry researcher identified over 300 neoclouds that can provide GPU capacity, up about 55% in less than a year.

zh.summary: 行业研究表明，现在超过300个新云提供商提供GPU容量，相比不到一年前增加了55%。这种扩展反映了对GPU访问日益增长的需求，并突出了企业获取计算资源的多种途径。

title: S&P 500 at 10,000 or bust: New ETF offers investors all-or-nothing bet on the index
summary: A newly launched ETF allows investors to make an all-or-nothing bet on whether the S&P 500 will reach 10,000. The product exemplifies Wall Street's trend of blurring lines between traditional investing and speculative gambling.
content: Wall Street has continued to blur the lines between investing and gambling with one recently launched exchange-traded fund.

zh.summary: 新推出的ETF允许投资者对标普500指数是否会达到10000进行全有或全无的押注。该产品体现了华尔街模糊传统投资和投机赌博之间界线的趋势。

title: Isaias weakens to post-tropical cyclone after Florida landfall, NHC says
summary: Hurricane Isaias made landfall in Florida as a major storm, weakening to a post-tropical cyclone afterward, causing widespread power outages affecting over 430,000 people in Florida and nearly 297,000 in Alabama. The storm demonstrates the significant impact tropical systems can have on infrastructure and communities.
content: More than 430,000 people in Florida and nearly 297,000 in Alabama lost power as the storm hit shore, according to power outage tracking firm PowerOutage.us.

zh.title: 国家飓风中心称艾萨亚斯在佛罗里达登陆后减弱为后热带气旋
zh.summary: 飓风艾萨亚斯以强风暴形式在佛罗里达登陆，随后减弱为后热带气旋，造成广泛停电，影响佛罗里达超过43万人和阿拉巴马州近29.7万人。该风暴表明热带风暴系统对基础设施和社区的重大影响。

title: Trump says Norway has 'indelible stain' for not awarding him Nobel Peace Prize
summary: Former President Trump criticized Norway for not awarding him the Nobel Peace Prize, continuing a pattern from his presidency. The statement reflects his ongoing focus on this recognition despite not receiving it during his tenure.
content: Each year of his presidency, Trump has expressed disappointment that he failed to win the prize.

zh.title: 特朗普称挪威未授予他诺贝尔和平奖是"永久污点"
zh.summary: 前总统特朗普批评挪威未授予他诺贝尔和平奖，继续延续他任期内的这一模式。该声明反映了他对这一认可的持续关注，尽管他在任期内未获得该奖项。

title: The world needs Ukraine’s grain. Its farmers are running out of reasons to plant
summary: Ukrainian farmers face financial constraints and lack incentive to plant crops for 2027 as grain exports remain blocked. Analysts warn that constrained supply could cause significant shifts in global commodity markets.
content: Cash-strapped farmers have no incentive to sow for 2027 with exports remaining trapped, as analysts say commodity markets could "flip fast."

zh.title: 世界需要乌克兰的谷物。其农民正在失去种植的理由
zh.summary: 乌克兰农民面临财务困难，由于谷物出口仍被阻止，他们缺乏种植2027年作物的动力。分析人士警告说，受限的供应可能会导致全球商品市场发生重大转变。

title: AI is changing how lawyers work — and putting the billable hour under pressure
summary: AI adoption is fundamentally transforming legal practice by forcing the profession to reconsider the traditional billable hour model. The technology is also challenging how lawyers develop and demonstrate expertise in an AI-augmented environment.
content: AI adoption is forcing the legal profession to rethink the billable hour and how lawyers build expertise.

zh.title: 人工智能正在改变律师的工作方式——并对计时收费制构成压力
zh.summary: 人工智能的采用正在从根本上改变法律实践，迫使该行业重新考虑传统的按小时计费模式。该技术还挑战了律师在人工智能增强环境中如何开发和展示专业知识。

title: Trump's diesel agreement with Putin accused of contradicting Russia sanctions law
summary: The Trump administration's reported diesel agreement with Russia faces criticism from Ukraine as potentially conflicting with existing sanctions. President Zelenskyy contends that easing sanctions undermines U.S. efforts to pressure Moscow economically.
content: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a searing statement that the U.S. easing sanctions on Moscow "plays into Russia's hands."

zh.title: 特朗普与普京的柴油协议被指违反俄罗斯制裁法
zh.summary: 特朗普政府报告的与俄罗斯达成的柴油协议面临乌克兰的批评，可能与现有制裁相冲突。泽连斯基总统主张，放宽制裁会削弱美国对莫斯科施加经济压力的努力。
